item.text: I’m making the API more cohesive now. The next step is to stop passing raw nested lists around and wrap the adjacency structure in a small `Graph` type so edge management and validation live in one place.
The graph wrapper is in place. I’m compiling and running it now to confirm the new source/graph split didn’t change the traversal or introduce access issues.

Refactored [BreadthFirstSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/004_breadth_first_search/BreadthFirstSearch.java) again to make the graph handling more cohesive.

- Kept BFS logic separate from graph mutation, so traversal now works against a clear graph abstraction ([lines 60-100](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/004_breadth_first_search/BreadthFirstSearch.java#L60)).
- Added `bfsFromSource(...)` in addition to whole-graph BFS, which makes the API more generally useful ([lines 93-100](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/004_breadth_first_search/BreadthFirstSearch.java#L93)).
- Kept the demo `main(...)` minimal and using the same sample graph setup ([lines 103-115](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/004_breadth_first_search/BreadthFirstSearch.java#L103)).
